about: Fields of data/weapon.dat (GTA San Andreas 1.0) for satk.addon. Lines start with '$' (gun data, one line per skill level), the pound sign 0xA3 (melee data) or '%' (aim offsets of a gun anim group); '#' starts a comment and a line containing ENDWEAPONDATA ends the data. key = satk name, col = column letter of the file header, mta = MTA setWeaponProperty name (absent = MTA cannot set it; mta_scale converts the file value), type f float | i int | x hex | s word, unit, desc.

gun.title: gun data: one line per weapon type and skill level

melee.title: melee data: one line per weapon type

aim.title: aim offsets per gun anim group

gun.name: weaponType
gun.desc: Weapon type name (PISTOL, AK47 ...); the engine has a fixed list of 47 types.

gun.name: eFireType
gun.desc: How the weapon fires: INSTANT_HIT bullets, PROJECTILE thrown or launched, AREA_EFFECT spray/flame, CAMERA, USE (goggles, detonator).

gun.name: targetRange
gun.desc: Distance at which the weapon locks on to targets.

gun.name: weaponRange
gun.desc: Distance the shots reach.

gun.name: modelId1
gun.desc: Model of the weapon (-1 = none). Its weap line in an IDE file must exist.

gun.name: modelId2
gun.desc: Second model (the satchel charge has the detonator), -1 = none.

gun.name: weaponSlot
gun.desc: Inventory slot 0-12; one weapon per slot.

gun.name: AssocGroupId
gun.desc: Animation group used to hold, aim and fire (colt45, rifle, ...); null = none.

gun.name: ammoClip
gun.desc: Rounds per clip before reloading.

gun.name: damage
gun.desc: Damage per hit.

gun.name: fireOffset.x
gun.desc: Muzzle position, X.

gun.name: fireOffset.y
gun.desc: Muzzle position, Y.

gun.name: fireOffset.z
gun.desc: Muzzle position, Z.

gun.name: skillLevel
gun.desc: Skill level of this line: 0 poor, 1 std, 2 pro, 3 cop (pistol only). Weapons without skill stats use the std line.

gun.name: reqStatLevel
gun.desc: Weapon skill stat needed to reach this skill level.

gun.name: accuracy
gun.desc: Accuracy multiplier (about 0.5-2.0).

gun.name: moveSpeed
gun.desc: Movement speed while aiming (about 0.5-1.5).

gun.name: animLoopStart
gun.desc: First frame of the firing loop (30 frames = 1 s).

gun.name: animLoopEnd
gun.desc: Last frame of the firing loop; with the start it sets the fire rate.

gun.name: animLoopFire
gun.desc: Frame of the loop at which the shot is fired.

gun.name: animLoop2Start
gun.desc: First frame of the second (crouched) firing loop.

gun.name: animLoop2End
gun.desc: Last frame of the second firing loop.

gun.name: animLoop2Fire
gun.desc: Frame of the second loop at which the shot is fired.

gun.name: breakoutTime
gun.desc: Frame after which the firing animation can be interrupted by moving.

gun.name: flags
gun.desc: Behaviour bits in hex: aiming, moving while aiming or firing, throwing, heavy, continuous fire, dual wield, reload and crouch animations. See 'satk data explain weapon flags'.

gun.name: speed
gun.desc: Projectile or particle speed (projectiles and area effects only).

gun.name: radius
gun.desc: Radius of the projectile or effect.

gun.name: lifespan
gun.desc: Lifetime of the projectile or particles.

gun.name: spread
gun.desc: Spread of the particles.

melee.name: targetRange
melee.desc: Distance at which the weapon locks on to targets.

melee.name: baseCombo
melee.desc: Fighting combo set used with this weapon.

melee.name: flags
melee.desc: Behaviour bits in hex (see 'satk data explain weapon flags').

melee.name: stealthAnimGroup
melee.desc: Animation group of stealth kills (knife: stealth_kn), null = none.

aim.name: animGroup
aim.desc: Gun anim group these offsets belong to (python, colt45, rifle ...).

flags.name: AIMWITHARM
flags.desc: aims with the arm only (pistols, uzis)

flags.name: CONTINUOUSFIRE
flags.desc: fires every frame of the loop

flags.name: RELOAD2START
flags.desc: loops from the end of the reload to the fire loop start
